title: The Shape of Safe

swarm.name: The Keepers
swarm.blurb: A machine swarm following an old shelter plan. It gathers, sorts and seals whatever it believes is in danger.

arc: The Keepers cross the parks, enclosing a landscape to match an old survey. The crew first thinks the swarm wants control, then follows it to a mineral collection and learns the enclosures are part of an emergency shelter plan. The plan treats ordinary change as a threat and turns protection into confinement. Its search for water leads into a connected karst system, where blocked channels endanger the people it was meant to protect. Wren, Ox and Kestrel break the controller’s links, restore the water and leave a corrected plan with local surveyors.

story.intro: The swarm has crossed into the parks. Paths fold shut behind it. Wren checks the abandoned camps while Ox tests the ground with his shield. Kestrel follows the machine tracks.

chapters.title: The fixed route
chapters.text: Machines stitch trails into single loops and send anything that strays back to the start. Kestrel finds the seams in their work. The crew assumes the swarm wants to control where people go.

chapters.title: The safe enclosure
chapters.text: Capsules hold plants away from their pollinators. Warmth is diverted from camps into sealed nests. Wren finds a machine keeping a specimen alive with unusual care. Control may be a means, not the goal.

chapters.title: An old record
chapters.text: Every enclosure matches an older survey. Ox sees that the exits have been braced from the outside. The machines seem to be protecting a recorded landscape from any further change.

story.bossIntro: The Forever Preserve rolls into view on a bed of folded maps. Capsules hang behind its plated doors. It seals a gap each time the crew opens one.
story.outro: The Preserve breaks open. Its last map points toward a mineral collection. Wren frees the specimens, while Kestrel pockets a shard carrying the same old survey. The swarm is still moving.

creatures.name: Contour Stitcher
creatures.blurb: It pulls map lines tight around another machine. Break its cover before the line closes.
creatures.look: A low brass spider carries pale cord spools and a folded green contour sheet across its back.

creatures.name: Dewpoint Tick
creatures.blurb: A cold shell cracks into smaller ticks when it is hurt.
creatures.look: A round steel tick with icy blue plates, six hooked legs and a bead of frost on its back.

creatures.name: Echo Bat
creatures.blurb: Its false return interrupts a crew member just as they move.
creatures.look: A charcoal bat with wide fan-shaped ears, silver wing ribs and a blue throat bulb.

creatures.name: Chorus Frog
creatures.blurb: Its song calls more machines. Silence it early.
creatures.look: A squat green metal frog with a ribbed yellow throat sac and four broad feet.

creatures.name: Recovery Collector
creatures.blurb: It repairs damaged capsules and the machines guarding them.
creatures.look: A cream cabinet on jointed legs holds glass pods; two fine arms carry a clamp and a soldering tip.

creatures.name: Birding Scope
creatures.blurb: Its lens marks a target for the rest of the patrol.
creatures.look: A long black telescope on three insect legs, with a wide amber lens and a swiveling hood.

creatures.name: Range Bison
creatures.blurb: It compacts a straight lane and charges down it.
creatures.look: A heavy brown mechanical bison with a roller chest, blunt horns and thick square hooves.

creatures.name: Fire Warden
creatures.blurb: Its expanding ring protects the warden while it smothers lamps.
creatures.look: A squat soot-gray stove on wheels with a circular iron fender and two shovel arms.

creatures.name: Habitat Sorter
creatures.blurb: It separates a mixed habitat and divides when its frame is damaged.
creatures.look: A tall white sorting machine with hinged wire pens, four wheels and green glass compartments.

creatures.name: Hot Spring Siphon
creatures.blurb: It shields its warm coil while feeding a new brood.
creatures.look: A coiled copper pipe serpent with steam vents, a broad valve head and small glowing amber tanks.

creatures.name: Field Auditor
creatures.blurb: It steals tools and interrupts anyone who tries to retrieve them.
creatures.look: A narrow gray mechanical figure with a hinged measuring arm, a canvas pouch and a blank oval face.

creatures.name: Forever Preserve
creatures.blurb: Its plated vaults protect the machines inside. Break through the shield and open the cages it keeps repairing.
creatures.look: A huge walking vault of gray stone and folded green maps, with glass specimen pods behind overlapping brass doors.

creatures.name: Park Steward
creatures.blurb: A local observer knows where the old maps no longer match the ground.
creatures.look: A traveler in a blue weatherproof coat with a field satchel and a small brass hand lens.

creatures.name: Shelter Repairer
creatures.blurb: A volunteer braces damaged shelters and protects others while they work.
creatures.look: A stocky worker in tan overalls carries a folded metal panel and a tool roll.

events.look: A dark cave mouth with a brass horn and bats clustered behind a wire screen.
events.title: False Echo
events.text: A projector traps bats behind a screen. Its horn answers every sound with a false return.

options.label: Imitate an open passage
options.result: The bats escape, but the horn catches the crew at close range.

options.label: Strip the horn for parts
options.result: The projector falls silent and yields useful brass. The bats must find their own way out.

events.look: Orange and yellow leaf piles conceal a fork and a small wooden marker.
events.title: Buried Junction
events.text: A family waits at a fork buried in sorted leaves. The sweeper is coming back.

options.label: Clear the marker together
options.result: The family finds the trail. The returning sweeper clips the crew.

options.label: Sell the loose metal rake
options.result: The family uses the remaining daylight to search while the crew takes the rake to trade.

events.look: A steaming pool feeds a copper pipe leading into a frost-covered machine nest.
events.title: Cold Spring
events.text: A siphon has taken the spring’s heat. Its valve also feeds a dormant nest.

options.label: Turn the valve
options.result: Warm water returns. The crew rests briefly before the nest begins to stir.

options.label: Salvage the valve wheel
options.result: The wheel is valuable. The pool stays cold for now.

events.look: A squat gate machine blocks an open tundra path with a rusted barrier.
events.title: Free Entry
events.text: A broken inspector demands payment at an entrance its records say is free.

options.label: Pay the mechanism
options.result: The barrier lifts immediately. The inspector keeps the coins.

options.label: Force the barrier
options.result: Ox bends the arm aside, but its spring snaps back into the crew.

events.look: A canvas field kit lies inside a wire cage beside a small tundra plot.
events.title: Field Kit
events.text: An auditor has seized a researcher’s equipment. The sample will not wait long.

options.label: Buy replacement tools
options.result: The researcher finishes the work with the new kit.

options.label: Cut open the cage
options.result: Kestrel recovers the original kit, with a scrape from the wire.

events.look: An open wooden trunk spills illustrated cards and a brass hand lens onto grass.
events.title: Traveling Classroom
events.text: A teacher needs scattered cards returned before the wind takes them. A spare hand lens lies in the trunk.

options.label: Collect the cards
options.result: The teacher shows the crew how to brace a load before it shifts. The search takes the remaining daylight.

options.label: Take the spare lens for trade
options.result: The lens brings a fair price. The teacher gathers the cards alone.

story.intro: The shard leads the crew to a mineral collection and its workshops. Crystals have been moved from their cases into new machine frames. Kestrel checks each joint for a weak seam.

chapters.title: Order and shelter
chapters.text: Sorters group people and objects by supposed origin. Some cases are armored and heated. Ox holds one open while Wren helps its occupants out.

chapters.title: The turn
chapters.text: Workshop records show the swarm is building a shelter, not merely preserving a collection. It copied an old emergency plan and now treats all movement as damage. Its cages are failed attempts to keep living things safe.

chapters.title: A missing connection
chapters.text: The plan needs a steady water supply. Its diagrams end at a cave network, but the cabinet is building pipes through occupied rooms. Kestrel finds the shared joints between the new armor and the supply lines.

story.bossIntro: The Cabinet of Tomorrow advances with specimen cases for armor. It grows supports from its cargo and calls smaller builders to close each opening. The water diagram hangs inside its frame.
story.outro: The cabinet falls apart when its supply joints are cut. Its diagram shows a central controller beneath the karst. Wren keeps the plan: the crew can stop the machinery without sealing the water away.

creatures.name: Locality Sorter
creatures.blurb: It takes loose gear for its geological shelves.
creatures.look: A wheeled steel rack with blue mineral plates, two pincers and a row of empty square trays.

creatures.name: Citation Borer
creatures.blurb: It tunnels toward repeated sounds, then bursts out in a straight charge.
creatures.look: A short brass mole with a spiral drill nose, tiny black eyes and broad digging feet.

creatures.name: Exposure Unit
creatures.blurb: Its pulsing beam coats a target in brittle mineral crust.
creatures.look: A black tripod lamp with a broad blue lens and a fan of pale crystalline fins.

creatures.name: Species Splitter
creatures.blurb: Its crystal body divides along a clean seam when damaged.
creatures.look: An angular white crystal beetle with a dark seam down its back and six jointed iron legs.

creatures.name: Archive Conservator
creatures.blurb: It repairs nearby machines with clear mineral shells.
creatures.look: A narrow wheeled cabinet with a glass dome, a vacuum hose and two fine silver repair arms.

creatures.name: Load Integrator
creatures.blurb: It overloads tools and interrupts their users.
creatures.look: A yellow copper-framed machine with thick black cables and two clamp hands.

creatures.name: Subsoil Prospector
creatures.blurb: Its drill charges through a guarded line.
creatures.look: A squat olive drilling rig on treads with a long steel auger and a round work lamp.

creatures.name: Credit Collector
creatures.blurb: It confiscates the tools used to finish a job.
creatures.look: A slim mechanical clerk with a square bronze torso, long arms and a deep canvas tool pouch.

creatures.name: Micro Architect
creatures.blurb: It folds model walls into protective cover for its builders.
creatures.look: A tall silver frame carrying hinged cream panels, a plumb weight and four articulated arms.

creatures.name: Co-design Assembler
creatures.blurb: It calls builders and shelters them behind fresh attachments.
creatures.look: A rolling workbench with green jointed arms, a vise mouth and a stack of small metal frames.

creatures.name: Five-Department Composite
creatures.blurb: Its linked modules repair their whole group. Interrupt the repair unit first.
creatures.look: Five mismatched brass and blue modules share a broad wheeled chassis, each with a different tool arm.

creatures.name: Cabinet of Tomorrow
creatures.blurb: It calls builders, shields them and sweeps the room with its frame. Break its construction line before it fills the floor.
creatures.look: A huge wheeled cabinet of dark wood and brass, with pale crystal cases, folding beams and a ring of long construction arms.

creatures.name: Curator Automaton
creatures.blurb: An independent cataloguer helps open cases and guards the people inside.
creatures.look: A compact cream robot with a glass lens, padded clamp hands and a flat protective tray.

creatures.name: Student Builder
creatures.blurb: A workshop volunteer repairs gear and makes practical diversions.
creatures.look: A person in a green work jacket and goggles carries a tool bag and a coil of wire.

events.look: A glowing battery sits among pale crystals in a cracked glass case.
events.title: Warm Battery
events.text: A battery is heating the specimens around it. A sorter is approaching.

options.label: Pull it out by hand
options.result: The specimens cool. The battery burns the crew through their gloves.

options.label: Sell the spare case fittings
options.result: The fittings fetch a price. The curator returns later to move the battery.

events.look: A narrow bridge is covered in pale crystalline crust under a blue lamp.
events.title: Crystal Bridge
events.text: Light feeds a spreading crust over the bridge. A shade could block it.

options.label: Carry the shade
options.result: The crew clears a path, taking a few cuts from the crust.

options.label: Buy a long pole
options.result: The pole holds the shade at a safe distance and is left with the people crossing.

events.look: Two unfolded diagrams lie on a steel desk beside a small lamp.
events.title: Conflicting Diagrams
events.text: Two diagrams disagree about a support. Checking the older copy will take time and supplies.

options.label: Consult the relay
options.result: The relay charges for a power cell and points out a safer brace.

options.label: Test the support
options.result: The support fails under a careful test. The crew finds the mistake the hard way.

events.look: A tiny model building holds up a full-size ceiling with a hanging weight.
events.title: Balanced Model
events.text: A model’s counterweight holds a corridor ceiling in place. The weight is valuable, but moving it is risky.

options.label: Crawl through in sequence
options.result: The slow crossing gives Wren time to tend minor injuries. The weight stays in place.

options.label: Take the counterweight
options.result: The crew slips through as the ceiling lowers. The weight can be traded.

events.look: A single generator feeds a kettle, a closed door and a small beacon.
events.title: Limited Supply
events.text: The generator can power only two devices. People behind the door need the beacon and the kettle.

options.label: Power the door and kettle
options.result: The crew shares hot water with the occupants. Their beacon stays dark.

options.label: Power the door and beacon
options.result: A technician guides the crew through clearing a bad circuit. The kettle remains cold.

events.look: A row of open doors shifts on rails around a small furnished room.
events.title: Moving Room
events.text: A housing machine keeps moving an empty room away from its owner. A loose rail can stop it.

options.label: Buy the rail from a scavenger
options.result: The rail jams the mechanism. The owner gets the room back.

options.label: Hold the doors apart
options.result: Ox holds them long enough for the owner to enter. A door catches the crew on the way out.

acts.name: Mineralogy Museum of the Paris School of Mines

story.intro: The water diagram leads underground. Springs, sinkholes and wells share passages the swarm has begun to seal. Ox tests every ledge before the crew crosses.

chapters.title: The same water
chapters.text: A well and a distant spring carry the same machine debris. Wren follows the flow instead of the marked corridors. The swarm is trying to secure a supply for its shelter.

chapters.title: A flawed safeguard
chapters.text: Sealed channels raise pressure under occupied ground. The controller still follows the emergency plan from the collection. It cannot distinguish a safe change in water flow from a threat.

chapters.title: Separate the links
chapters.text: Surveyors trace three links: a surface marker, boring limbs and a spring-mouth core. Kestrel finds where the links meet. Ox plans a route that leaves the water passages open.

story.bossIntro: The Karst Mandate rises through the floor. Its surveyor marks targets while its limbs bore new channels. The spring-mouth core shields the whole machine and sends water across the chamber.
story.outro: The crew breaks the links to the core and opens the blocked channels. Water returns to the well and spring. The swarm wanted a permanent shelter for living things, but its old plan made a prison. Wren leaves the corrected diagram with the surveyors; the crew moves on.

creatures.name: Solution Miner
creatures.blurb: It dissolves cover and marks targets for the boring machines.
creatures.look: A small gray crawler with a narrow nozzle, blue fluid tank and four gripping legs.

creatures.name: Humidity Regulator
creatures.blurb: It condenses a protective mist around damaged machines.
creatures.look: A round silver fan on three feet with a clear water reservoir and a ring of white vapor nozzles.

creatures.name: Spring Siphon
creatures.blurb: It pulls loose equipment into the current.
creatures.look: A slender blue-gray pipe serpent with a circular suction mouth and flexible ribbed body.

creatures.name: Formation Weaver
creatures.blurb: It grows mineral strands over allies to protect them.
creatures.look: A chalk-white spider with long wire legs and dangling amber mineral threads.

creatures.name: Collapse Beetle
creatures.blurb: It braces a slab, then charges as the stone falls.
creatures.look: A broad brown beetle with stone plates, thick piston legs and a flat slab balanced on its back.

creatures.name: Fossil Assessor
creatures.blurb: It casts fresh footprints and uses them to pin their maker in place.
creatures.look: A tan box on spindly legs with a wide plaster nozzle and a pair of round blue lenses.

creatures.name: Artifact Extractor
creatures.blurb: It removes tools under a ring of probing arms.
creatures.look: A low brass machine with a circular probe frame, a mesh basket and four rubber wheels.

creatures.name: Lampenflora Imitator
creatures.blurb: Its mechanical mat splits and spreads when cut.
creatures.look: A mat of dark green metal fronds with tiny pale bulbs and rootlike copper wires.

creatures.name: Aquifer Custodian
creatures.blurb: Its interlocking scales seal the channel and protect other machines.
creatures.look: A thick slate-blue mechanical eel with overlapping shield scales and a broad circular valve head.

creatures.name: Grant Planter
creatures.blurb: Its buried pods call machines when water reaches them. Rush it before the nest grows.
creatures.look: A bronze seedpod on jointed root legs, with a short survey mast and glowing green seed chambers.

creatures.name: Hypogene Borer
creatures.blurb: It rises beneath cover and drives through a shielded front.
creatures.look: A heavy black drilling cylinder with a pale stone cutting crown and four hydraulic braces.

creatures.name: Karst Mandate
creatures.blurb: Its core shields itself, calls boring machines and sweeps the chamber. Break the guarded links before its reinforcements overwhelm the crew.
creatures.look: A vast gray stone and brass machine with a circular spring-mouth core, three drilling limbs and a tall survey mast.

creatures.name: Water Monitor
creatures.blurb: A surveyor traces the flow and helps keep the crew fit to follow it.
creatures.look: A surveyor in a blue waterproof coat carries a sample bottle, field bag and compact lamp.

creatures.name: Cave Interpreter
creatures.blurb: A volunteer guides people around fragile formations and shields them from falling debris.
creatures.look: A person in a tan helmet and green jacket carries a broad folded canvas shield and a small lantern.

events.look: Fresh footprints end beside a pale cast on a muddy cave floor.
events.title: Cast Footprints
events.text: An assessor is hunting the person whose footprints it copied. They are hiding nearby.

options.label: Draw the assessor away
options.result: The person slips out while the crew takes a glancing hit.

options.label: Sell the discarded casting tools
options.result: The tools bring useful supplies. The person waits for a quieter chance to leave.

events.look: A clear spring spills metal parts and a canvas pouch onto a rocky bank.
events.title: Lost Equipment
events.text: The spring is returning lost gear. A narrow crack upstream holds more.

options.label: Reach into the crack
options.result: The crew recovers a pouch, but sharp stone cuts their hands.

options.label: Collect loose parts downstream
options.result: The loose metal is easy to trade. The pouch stays lodged upstream.

events.look: Two metal machines stand beside a tripod on visibly cracked ground.
events.title: Sagging Tripod
events.text: Two machines debate the type of sinkhole while their tripod sinks.

options.label: Pull the tripod free
options.result: The tripod comes loose as the ground drops underfoot.

options.label: Buy a rope and anchor
options.result: The crew hauls the tripod from a safe distance and leaves the rope for surveyors.

events.look: A dim cave passage has green metal fronds growing toward a lamp.
events.title: Dark Route
events.text: A surveyor is stranded behind a mat that grows toward their lamp.

options.label: Guide them out in darkness
options.result: The surveyor gets clear. The crew stumbles against the rock.

options.label: Redirect the lamp with a mirror
options.result: A purchased mirror draws the mat aside and the surveyor escapes.

events.look: A forked cave passage carries a cloud of dust past a fluttering cloth.
events.title: Reversed Airflow
events.text: A distress call comes from one branch and machine dust from the other. The draft is shifting.

options.label: Follow the call now
options.result: The crew reaches a stranded traveler but takes a lungful of dust.

options.label: Wait for the dust to settle
options.result: Wren tends the crew during the wait. The traveler finds another route out.

events.look: A narrow crack reveals a white stone column behind a newly built wall.
events.title: Old Field Guide
events.text: A survey team’s old route ends at a wall. A familiar formation shows through a crack.

options.label: Widen the crack
options.result: Kestrel opens a route and catches falling grit.

options.label: Trade for the team’s spare map
options.result: The surveyors exchange a lesson in breaking shields for the crew’s remaining lamp fuel.

acts.name: National Cave and Karst Research Institute
